Author: PartyPing
Name: PartyPing
Punchline: Discord alerts when Party Finder hits my prog point.
Description: Polls the in-game FFXIV Party Finder, filters by duty, prog keywords, open slots, exact local role availability, and ignores listings locked to minimum item level 999. Discord bot mode adds native Open in FFXIV and Join Party buttons plus a live joined-party tracker card that replaces PF cards while you are in a party and updates as members join or leave. Use /partyping to configure it.
